messages:
Eli Navarro: hey everyone :wave: i'm eli — started today as a product engineer (they/them). based in boston, remote. big into speedcubing (3x3 sub-10 pb!) and tabletop rpgs — always scheming a new one-shot. excited to be here and meet folks. open to coffee chat slots this week.
Alex Chen: welcome eli!! :tada: we actually have a casual game night thursday evenings, would love to have you join — ping me and i'll add you to the group. also coffee slots fri morning?
Jamie Ortiz: hi eli!! welcome!! do you have a preferred coffee order or mug superstition? ☕️
Eli Navarro: @Jamie haha yes — double oat latte, low-sugar. i bring my old travel mug that's stickers-covered.
Priya Singh: hey eli, welcome!! if you want to run a one-shot sometime the product team is always down for improv rpg. also we have a tiny speedcubing crew in the office kitchen on mondays after lunch :smile:
Alex Chen: random but useful: onboarding slack channel has badge pickup slot info and desk assignments.
Onboarding Bot: Welcome, Eli! To-do: badge pickup, equipment request form, benefits intro session. Links: <https://intranet/recs/onboard|badge pickup> · <https://intranet/recs/equip|equipment form>. If you need help, reply with "help".
Eli Navarro: thanks all — can someone point me to where we sign up for game night? i can bring a short rules-light dungeon.
Alex Chen: i'll DM invite. also if anyone wants to see a cubing solve, i'll bring Eli's mini-cube to the kitchen at 3:15 today :grin: — meet me there!
Jamie Ortiz: omg yes. cubing + snacks = peak productivity. welcome again!!
Eli Navarro: see you at 3:15 — and thanks for the warm welcome :heart:
